# configuration file /etc/nginx/nginx.conf:
user www-data;
worker_processes auto;
include /etc/nginx/modules-enabled/*.conf;

events {
	worker_connections 768;
}

http {
	sendfile on;
	include /etc/nginx/mime.types;
	log_format main '$remote_addr - "$request" {braces in quotes}';

	upstream front_nodes {
		server 10.0.1.31:3000 weight=2;
		server 10.0.1.32:3000;
		keepalive 16;
	}

	include /etc/nginx/conf.d/*.conf;
	include /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/*;
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/modules-enabled/50-mod-stream.conf:
load_module modules/ngx_stream_module.so;

# configuration file /etc/nginx/mime.types:
types {
    text/html  html htm;
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/client.conf:
# Symfony API, PHP-FPM
server {
	listen 443 ssl http2;
	listen [::]:443 ssl http2;
	server_name staging.client.fr www.staging.client.fr;
	root /var/www/client/current/public;

	location / {
		try_files $uri /index.php$is_args$args;
	}
	location ~ ^/index\.php(/|$) {
		fastcgi_pass unix:/run/php/php8.2-fpm.sock;
		include fastcgi_params;
	}
}

server {
	listen 80;
	server_name staging.client.fr;
	return 301 https://$host$request_uri;
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/front:
server {
	listen 127.0.0.1:8080;
	server_name "front.client.fr";
	set $PORT_SIMU 3010;

	location /api/ {
		proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:8000/api/;
	}
	location / {
		root /var/www/front/current/dist;
		if ($http_upgrade) {
			proxy_pass http://front_nodes;
		}
	}
	location /ws {
		proxy_pass http://unix:/run/front.sock:/ws;
	}
	location /dyn {
		proxy_pass http://${backend}$request_uri;
	}
	location /simu {
		proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:$PORT_SIMU;
	}
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/sites-enabled/default:
server {
	listen *:8081 default_server;
	server_name _;
	location / { uwsgi_pass 127.0.0.1:3031; }
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/conf.d/status.conf:
server {
	listen localhost;
	location /nginx_status { stub_status; }
}

# configuration file /etc/nginx/fastcgi_params:
fastcgi_param  QUERY_STRING  $query_string;
